name: codex-session-pulse
description: A small overlay over Codex Desktop showing the last observed prompt-cache read and a TTL estimate.

interface.longDescription: Shows a small non-activating overlay over Codex Desktop with the last observed cached-input and input token counts and an estimate of the prompt-cache TTL. Rollout JSONL files are the source of truth; lifecycle hooks only make updates faster.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain what the Codex Session Pulse overlay is showing for this session.
